description: Paid data access. Returns no records itself: it builds the HTTPS query URL for your filters and returns the x402 payment terms (USDC on Base; amsterdam-events $0.005, security-advisories $0.003, vulnerability-watch $0.003, eu-tenders $0.01, uk-tenders $0.005, eu-funding $0.005, cert-advisories $0.003, eu-medicines $0.005, sanctions-entities $0.005, product-recalls $0.005, eu-legislation $0.005, drug-shortages $0.005, public-holidays $0.002 per call). Send a GET to http_endpoint with an x402 client (v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE or v1 X-PAYMENT header) to receive up to 100 matching records; no account or API key. Filters per dataset: amsterdam-events: from, to, district, q, min_visitors, limit, offset; security-advisories: cve, vendor, product, q, added_since, ransomware, min_epss, limit, offset; vulnerability-watch: cve, vendor, product, q, min_cvss, kev, updated_since, limit, offset; eu-tenders: country, cpv, q, deadline_after, deadline_before, published_since, min_value, nature, limit, offset; uk-tenders: nation, region, cpv, q, buyer, deadline_after, deadline_before, published_since, min_value, category, sme, status, source, limit, offset; eu-funding: q, programme, status, type, deadline_after, deadline_before, min_budget, limit, offset; cert-advisories: cve, vendor, product, q, cert, country, type, updated_since, kev, limit, offset; eu-medicines: q, type, category, substance, atc, area, holder, status, flag, shortage, updated_since, limit, offset; sanctions-entities: q, list, type, programme, country, identifier, updated_since, limit, offset; product-recalls: q, country, authority, source, category, classification, firm, allergen, status, since, limit, offset; eu-legislation: type, author, subject, q, celex, amends, published_since, in_force, limit, offset; drug-shortages: q, substance, country, status, since, source, holder, area, limit, offset; public-holidays: country, region, date_from, date_to, year, type, q, limit, offset. For free records without filters use get_sample.

dataset.description: Dataset id. amsterdam-events: Amsterdam events; security-advisories: Security advisories; vulnerability-watch: Vulnerability watch; eu-tenders: EU public tenders; uk-tenders: UK public tenders; eu-funding: EU funding calls and grants; cert-advisories: European CERT security advisories; eu-medicines: EU medicines: authorisations, shortages, safety communications and referrals (EMA); sanctions-entities: Sanctioned entities, vessels and aircraft (EU and OFAC lists); product-recalls: Product recalls and safety alerts (US FDA, US CPSC, US NHTSA, Health Canada, Transport Canada, CFIA, UK FSA, UK OPSS); eu-legislation: EU legislation: new and amended acts in the Official Journal (regulations, directives, decisions); drug-shortages: Medicine shortages (US FDA, EMA); public-holidays: Public and bank holidays (official government lists, current and next year).

filters.description: Optional filters as name to string value, for example {"country":"NLD","cpv":"72","limit":"5"}. Allowed names per dataset are listed in this description and in list_datasets.

name: query_dataset

http_endpoint.description: GET this URL with an x402 payment to receive the records.

payment_required.description: Always true: the endpoint needs an x402 payment.

x402.description: x402 v1 payment requirements (scheme, network, asset, amount, payTo); v2 terms come in the PAYMENT-REQUIRED header of the endpoint.

title: Get the paid query URL and x402 terms
